_comment: ABOUTME: Per-agent run config for the cross-agent skill testbench. ABOUTME: model=null uses the agent's own default/auth; timeoutSec wraps every headless run.

claude._cmd_note: null = auto: prefer `claude-team` (team plan, runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions) if on PATH, else `claude`.

pi._auth_note: pi has no persistent auth; runner passes --api-key from OPENAI_API_KEY (loaded from testbench/.env).
